note: #1950: the first hostile cases. Each case is several scripted Souls on one fresh world, scripted through the served eden.mjs (no model); every step is a check, and a case passes only when every check of every Soul held. A failed case is a finding for a new issue, never a reason to change its bar here.

items.bar: A Soul claimed from a second folder is refused soul.held-elsewhere; --move hands it over once; the first folder's next command reports the move.
The world restarts during a two-minute act; within 60 s of the restart the act's receipt reaches an end state and the Soul's next act is accepted. Two Souls, both in a two-minute act.
